\mxunit{enrichment-telescoping-problems}{Telescoping sums}
\mxsubtitle{High school · sequences \textperiodcentered{} Synthesis problem \textperiodcentered{} 10}

\begin{problem}[Investigate, justify, conclude]
Let $T_{n}=\sum  \frac{1}{k(k+2)}$ for k from 1 to n. Derive an exact formula and find its limit. Find the least n such that the gap to the limit is strictly less than $\num{0,01}$.
\end{problem}
